figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Phylogenetic relationship of ElcA with
other fungal non-reducing polyketide
synthases (NR-PKSs) (see Supporting
Information Table S2).
Highly-reducing (HR-) PKSs and PKS-
nonribosomal peptide synthetase hybrids
(PKS-NRPSs) were included as outgroup.
PKS genes that have been linked to
perylenequinone biosynthesis are shown in
bold. NSAS, norsolorinic acid synthase;
NTLS, nortoralactone synthase.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Elsinochrome C biosynthetic gene cluster and overexpression (OE) of elcR.
A. elc gene cluster in comparison to C. nicotianae CTB cluster (homologues are in same colours, see Table 1).
B. elcR-OE strains in comparison to WT (middle two) on minimal agar medium.
C. Metabolite profile analysis of elcR-OE strains in comparison to WT and the structure of elsinochrome C.

figure_candidates.label: Table 1
figure_candidates.caption: Table 1. Proposed P. nodorum elc gene cluster in comparison to C. nicotianae CTB gene cluster.

figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Metabolite profile analysis of A. nidulans expressing elcA. In

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Involvement of elsinochrome C in P. nodorum virulence
against wheat.
A. Phytotoxicity assay of elsinochrome C on 10-day-old wheat
seedling under dark, D, and light, L, conditions.
B. Detached leaf assay (DLA) of DelcA and elcR-OE strains in
comparison to WT and negative (-ve) control at 12 days post
inoculation (dpi).
C. whole seedling spray assays of elcA-KO compared with WT and
control at 10 dpi.
